headline: Pakistan and Turkmenistan will review progress on the roughly $10 billion TAPI gas pipeline at the sixth session of their Intergovernmental Commission in Islamabad on Tuesday, co-chaired by Deputy PM Ishaq Dar and Turkmen Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Dar and Meredov co-chair commission session in Islamabad

caption:
Pakistan and Turkmenistan to review the $10 billion TAPI gas pipeline today ⛽🇵🇰🇹🇲
Arab News reports that Deputy PM Ishaq Dar and Turkmen Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov will co-chair the sixth session of the Pakistan-Turkmenistan Intergovernmental Commission in Islamabad on Tuesday. The roughly 1,800 km pipeline is planned to carry about 33 billion cubic meters of gas a year from Turkmenistan's Galkynysh field, but work has stalled for years. The TAP electricity transmission project is also on the agenda.
